title: A New Life for a Software Engineer
style_block: warm, soft natural light, a hand-painted feel, muted earth tones, grainy film texture
character: a young Ethiopian woman software developer in her early twenties, shoulder-length black hair, plain grey sweater, at a wooden desk with a laptop

shots.picture: She sits at a wooden desk at dawn, a closed laptop in front of her, soft light from a window.
shots.reason: Sets the time and place, her home office in Addis Ababa.

shots.narration: I was sure it could never be as good as a developer like me, so I brushed it off.
shots.picture: She looks at a glowing laptop screen, uncertain.

shots.narration: I didn't think it would get this far.
shots.picture: She closes the laptop with a small shrug.
shots.reason: Shows her dismissing AI, which sets up the later regret.

shots.narration: But the models kept getting stronger, and then the layoffs started.
shots.picture: Abstract glowing screens with rising lines.
shots.reason: Shows the pace of change without a face.

shots.narration: Companies cut teams one after another, and the fear crept closer to my own desk.
shots.picture: An empty office chair pushed back from a desk.
shots.reason: Puts the layoffs into one image.

shots.narration: I began to question my own ability.
shots.picture: Her hands hover over a keyboard, not touching it.
shots.reason: Makes the fear personal through her hands.

shots.narration: Writing code slowly became writing prompts,
shots.picture: A glowing prompt box where lines of code used to be.

shots.narration: and the skills I'd spent years building began slipping away from me.
shots.picture: A code editor fades to a dim screen.

shots.narration: So I stopped watching, and I started building again, this time with AI.
shots.picture: She opens a notebook and starts sketching.

shots.narration: Maybe the future of software isn't about competing with it.
shots.picture: She looks up from her screen, calm and steady.
shots.reason: Gives a calm moment before the hope.

shots.narration: Maybe it's about learning to build with it.
shots.picture: She builds something on her laptop in warm evening light.
shots.reason: Shows the hopeful outcome in action.

shots.narration: The world is changing. And so can we.
shots.picture: A plain warm background, no picture.
shots.reason: The end card. The text and 'Made with AI' are added in code, since AI-generated text tends to come out garbled.
